services.hero.title: Services
services.title: All Services Available
services.subtitle: Simplify Living services can be booked in person in the Frankfurt am Main area or online from anywhere in the world.
services.service1.title: Clothes and More
services.service1.intro1: Your wardrobe is overflowing, yet you have nothing to wear?
services.service1.intro2: We'll sort through your clothes, shoes, and accessories together, and create a system that makes getting dressed easy and fun.
services.service1.li2: Joy-check every piece of clothing with confidence
services.service1.li3: Learn smart folding and storage methods
services.service1.li4: Reorganise your wardrobe so you can finally enjoy your favourite outfits again
services.service2.title: Paperwork
services.service2.intro1: Can't find that warranty? Or your tax documents? No problem. In the future you'll find everything at once.
services.service2.intro2: I'll help you to sensibly reduce your paperwork and show you a filing system that keeps its promise in the long term.
services.service2.li4: Discover space-saving filing systems that actually work
services.service3.title: Declutter with kids
services.service3.intro1: It's not always easy to create a tidy, comfortable home that also supports your children's development. Together with the kids, we'll bring order in a playful, age-appropriate way, leaving plenty of space for creative play.
services.service3.intro2: Drawing on my years as an elementary school teacher, I know easy strategies to help your family keep things organised.
services.service3.li2: Discover storage solutions that save space and fit your lifestyle
services.service3.li3: Arrange your home to fit the current needs of your family
services.service3.li4: Establish ideal conditions for playful learning and creative exploration
services.service4.title: All in
services.service4.intro1: Are you ready for a full transformation? 'All in' is your complete decluttering journey.
services.service4.intro2: Together over the course of at least six months, we'll systematically organise your entire home and design spaces that truly fit your life.
services.service4.li1: Define your tidying journey with confidence
services.service4.li2: Work closely with me over at least six months
services.service4.li3: Receive regular in-person or online guidance
services.service4.li4: Get ongoing written support while creating your feel-good home
services.final-cta.title: Let's simplify your home together
services.final-cta.p1: Still not sure where to begin?
services.final-cta.p2: Book a free, no-obligation initial consultation and we'll find out together.
